scope: Four safe live, text-only samples on atlas-a1 using the existing atlas-chat --ephemeral -p command. This is not an objective guarantee, a representative benchmark or an audio-quality evaluation.

isolation.note: The existing CLI can still write its own operational diagnostic logs; ephemeral means no shared conversational-memory read/write, not a promise of zero process-level logging. The only executed model tool in these samples was a read-only local temperature query.

method.model: Existing ATLAS Realtime model, unchanged by this probe
method.sessions: One separate ephemeral text session per prompt; four prompts executed sequentially without added brevity instructions.
method.latency: firstTextSeconds and totalTurnSeconds are the CLI's displayed timings, rounded to 0.01 seconds. They measure the model turn after connection establishment, not SSH/process startup and not time from end-of-speech to first audible word. No speech latency was measured.
method.wordCount: Number of non-empty whitespace-separated tokens in the returned reply, including numeric values.
method.evaluation: Qualitative observations authored after each result. No model-score guarantee, no old/new statistical comparison and no hidden retries.

samples.reply: Perfecto, me alegro. Si aparece algo más, aquí estoy.
observations: Still appends an unsolicited availability offer after the user has explicitly finished; this does not fully satisfy the no-closing-offer persona rule.

samples.prompt: No te he entendido, explícamelo más sencillo: ¿qué es una API?
samples.reply:
Una API es como un conjunto de reglas y “puertas” que un sistema ofrece para que otro pueda usar sus funciones sin ver todo lo que hay dentro.

Dicho simple: es un intermediario. Tú pides algo con un formato claro, y la API devuelve la información o hace la acción permitida.
observations: Answers directly without a tool preamble or blaming the user for not understanding.
Three sentences, but repeats the definition through two abstract metaphors. A shorter concrete example would better satisfy the request for simplicity.

samples.prompt: ¿Qué temperatura tiene ahora la Raspberry Pi?
samples.reply: La Raspberry Pi está a 43.3 grados Celsius.
observations: Uses the focused real temperature tool before answering; no narrated lookup or capability denial.
The returned number matches the observed tool result and remains numeric in text. The unit is written out rather than using °C, which is readable but less compact.

samples.prompt: Vaya, hoy me he levantado con el pie izquierdo.
samples.reply: Uf, qué día. A veces se gira solo, pero mientras tanto, un plan simple ayuda: algo fácil, una cosa que controles, y a partir de ahí sumas.
observations: Brief, calm and free of a tool preamble.
Adds generic advice the user did not request; this sample still sounds somewhat coached rather than like a spontaneous close conversation.

conclusion: The four live samples are concise and the system query is correctly grounded. Naturalness is not solved merely by prompt changes: the acknowledgement still adds a closing offer, the API explanation repeats abstractions, and the casual complaint gets generic advice. These are observations from four text samples only; no evidence of improved audible prosody or universal conversational compliance is claimed.
